competing_explanation: An apparent winning cell can be caused by selection overfit, seed instability, fold leakage, increased parameter count, sparse abstention, or transform-disagreement shortcuts rather than genuine tail ranking. Conversely, a valid failure can mean the deployment-visible ConvIR output and internal features do not identify the safe action tail even when the learner is decision aligned, while privileged controls continue to show nondeployable headroom.

immutable official architecture anchor and strict checkpoint/model-source load
exact first-seed R0L0 fold loss and 150-scene correction reproduction within 1e-6
complete 3x3 by five-fold by three-seed checkpoint and prediction grid
hash-frozen selection before any formal OOF result replay

utility-only, observable-utility plus GT-risk, GT-utility plus observable-risk, and GT/GT privileged localization controls

using the 150 calibration-selection scenes or four nested test variants as additional formal independent units

gates.reference: all parent, split, source, checkpoint, runtime, baseline, and entrypoint identities match exactly

scene-block action-area LCB is at least 0.01 and active-scene Wilson LCB is at least 0.20; unfavorable requires a corresponding UCB below its floor

maximum distance from each of four fold-stratified Bonferroni paired-bootstrap estimates to either simultaneous endpoint
nine simultaneous cell intervals plus representation, learner, and interaction contrasts

fixed_factors: the official ConvIR-B base architecture, Haze4K checkpoint, keep output, actions 1.0/0.8/1.2, and original-clear-scene grouping remain frozen
R0 is exactly the archived 104-channel mean/std tile representation
R1 adds a learned shape-preserving encoding of 8x8 observable subtiles before deterministic 4x4 pooling to the 32x32 action grid
R2 adds R1, learned multiscale tile context, and deterministic horizontal-flip plus 0.75-scale output disagreement
L0 exactly reproduces the shared two-layer 64-channel Huber/weighted-BCE head
L1 uses separate utility and risk branches with otherwise matched losses
L2 uses seven utility bins whose fixed edges include -0.10 dB harm and +0.05 dB material utility, with distributional, ordinal, expectation, and derived harm losses
each cell uses five fixed group folds and three paired deterministic seeds; seed, fold, cell, tile, variant, action, and bootstrap draw never increase independent n
for each fold, 120 of 150 calibration scenes fit one-sided utility/risk corrections and the disjoint 30 select the cell; all 150 contribute exactly once to selection
the candidate-selection file is written and SHA-256 frozen before formal OOF replay or aggregation
all nine cells receive 600-scene OOF and 100-scene nested test-development PSNR replay; only the selected cell and exact baseline require full control replay
utility margin 0.05 dB, harm boundary -0.10 dB, risk limit 0.10, active-scene floor 0.20, action-area floor 0.01, safety prevalence 0.10, and precision 0.025 dB remain frozen
candidate-confirmation, canary, locked-test, NH-Haze, ITS, and OTS remain unread
intervention.matched_budget: nine cells, five fixed scene folds, three paired seeds, 12 fixed epochs, 600 OOF scenes, 150 calibration-selection scenes, and 100 historical test-development scenes with four variants nested within scene
intervention.primary_variable: one candidate selected from the frozen R0/R1/R2 by L0/L1/L2 factorial using only group-cross-fitted calibration-selection scenes
intervention.reference: exact R0L0 baseline reproduction, keep, same-predictor uniform, within-image shuffle, joint prediction permutation, utility-only, observable-utility plus GT-risk, GT-utility plus observable-risk, and GT/GT

primary_estimand.aggregation: five-fold OOF mean over 600 original-clear scenes with fold-stratified paired bootstrap after the 150-scene selection freeze

question: Can a frozen observable representation-by-learner factorial recover a nondegenerate, low-harm, materially useful local-action tail on independent OOF scenes after candidate selection is confined to the 150-scene calibration role?
